notes: Big word that floats up beside the board when every fish of one kind has popped off of it, and that kind goes up the ladder on the left (no more of it drops in). A short exclamation.

Tiny label under a rung of the ladder beside the board (about 34 px wide, 10 px tall): swapping that rung off to the left doubles the multiplier. It also floats up when that happens. Keep it as short as x2.

Tiny label under the top rung of the ladder beside the board (about 34 px wide, 10 px tall): swapping it off to the left sends all three kinds of fish on the ladder away for the rest of the game. One short word if possible.
Big words that float up when three kinds of fish have been sent away for the rest of the game.

Tiny label under a rung of the ladder beside the board (about 34 px wide, 10 px tall): swapping that rung off to the left triples the multiplier. It also floats up when that happens. Keep it as short as x3.

Tiny label inside the box to the left of the top rung of the ladder beside the board (about 24 px wide, 12 px tall): swapping that rung off to the left halves the move count of the game so far (fewer moves is a better score). Keep it as short as possible; the ÷2 is the same everywhere.
Big words that float up when the top rung of the ladder is swapped off to the left and the move count of the game is cut in half (fewer moves is a better score).

Tiny label inside the box to the left of the top rung of the ladder beside the board (wrapped onto two lines in a 24 px box): swapping that rung off to the left halves the move count of the game so far (fewer moves is a better score). The word for moves, then /2. Keep the /2 the same everywhere.
